Interface RouteResolution<T,R>

Type Parameters:
T - The target type
R - The result type
All Known Implementing Classes:
RouteResolution.Matched, RouteResolution.NotFound, RouteResolution.Pending
@Internal public sealed interface RouteResolution<T,R> permits RouteResolution.Matched<T,R>, RouteResolution.NotFound<T,R>, RouteResolution.Pending<T,R>
The outcome of resolving the route of a request: a match, no route, or matches that depend on the body of the request, which the server chooses among once it read the body, see PendingRouteMatch.
Since:
5.3.0

Denis Stepanov
